previous_record.title: Reduction of arbitrary constant compression to a 46-dimensional outer space
previous_record.statement: Over C, the certified 112-dimensional limiting space L of the specified two-sided A4 conjugation has the stated exact four-by-four outer block form. Every element of ordinary rank at most four is confined to block (3,0), whose matrix space E=G+[G,G00]+G00 G G00 has dimension 46 in Mat28. The kernel of any constant rank-110 long-leg compression is therefore exactly a compression kernel of E. A full M(10,10,11) target requires a rank-26 pair Phat, Chat with dim(Phat E Chat)<=37, equivalently a 26-dimensional U and two-dimensional W with dim{E in E:E(U) subset W}>=9.
dependencies: AI-RESOLVENT-SHARP-MINRANK-001 Section 2: every nonzero matrix in G+G00 G has rank at least six
Credited minimum nonzero source rank sixteen
112 exact block-coordinate identities, 16 exact transpose-conjugation identities, and elementary two-sided projection rank inequality
previous_record.limitations: Necessary reduction for the one specified fixed conjugation family with constant full-rank long-map compressions. The universal reduced lower bound 38 is not proved, arbitrary constant compressions are not excluded, and satisfying the reduced condition is not sufficient for a full target. Same-session reasoning checks are not independent review. No formalization or exponent improvement.

previous_record.title: Nine-direction rank-loss requirement for a full-source two-sided A4 conjugation
previous_record.statement: Over C, conjugate the complete 112-dimensional normalized A4 slice space by I+t^-1 N, with the specified square-zero rank-sixteen source slice N=H_(0,0,0). Its complete saturated limit L acts by scalars on the stated twelve-dimensional subspace. For arbitrary constant full-rank maps P:C^112->C^110 and C:C^110->C^112, and an arbitrary Laurent first map, a degeneration to M(10,10,11) requires dim(P L C)<=103. Re-saturation recovers at most the number of lost leading directions, while the target has nonzero evaluation rank at least ten.
dependencies: Credited literal cyclic A4 source and unimodular source-unit normalization
Exact complete polynomial-combination certificate with 112 independent leading matrices and twelve scalar-action columns
Elementary saturated-lattice specialization, Grassmann dimension inequality and target evaluation rank
previous_record.limitations: One specified two-sided conjugation family with constant long-leg compressions. The necessary rank-loss locus is not classified. Moving compressions, other source paths and other nilpotent factors remain outside the result. Exact coefficient replay and same-session proof checks are not independent mathematical review. No full target, formalization or exponent improvement.
